disputes.safe: Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation and keep a manual Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
disputes.title: Positive Mental Attitude — 15 vs 18, and does the Chapter 1 balcony count?

versions.label: A — 18 needed, balcony pending
versions.text: 18 meditations at 10 spots. The Chapter 1 balcony raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot; the PowerPyx author earned the trophy after doing it — status pending confirmation.

versions.label: B — balcony counts, firmly
versions.text: OutputLag states the Chapter 1 balcony (Lucia) DOES count and vanishes after that chapter.

versions.label: C — unsure
versions.text: eGamers reports the walkthrough author was not sure the balcony counts.

versions.label: D — no missable at all
versions.text: Push Square records no missable trophy and estimates 300+ hours.

versions.label: Middle fact — the arithmetic
versions.text: The 100% checklist needs only 15 of 18 meditations — all sides agree. The 18 break down as 8 spots x 2 (both characters) + balcony (1) + Ascent (1).

disputes.safe: Work on Race Against Yago as soon as the hourglass icon appears in Chapter 3; save first. Check the trophy counter after each strand — the game never says which strands counted.
disputes.title: Strangers & Freaks — 8 strands vs 4 confirmed; can one be missed?

versions.label: A — every strand stays available
versions.text: PowerPyx: all stranger strands stay available after the story. Only 4 strands are confirmed as counting (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete); others remain undiscovered.

versions.label: B — Yago can lock you out
versions.text: Game-Checklists: skipping Race Against Yago can lock you out of Yago's missions. OutputLag: do it when the hourglass appears, save first. The PowerPyx walkthrough marks Race Against Yago time-sensitive and missable.

versions.label: C — single-source warning
versions.text: eGamers cites TechWiser: the stranger chain behind 5 hidden trophies has story-progress windows. Only one source gives this warning.

disputes.safe: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI) and play normally — most players earn it without trying. Avoid the permanent Irredeemable tier.
disputes.title: Actions Speak Louder — the '500 actions' count

versions.label: A — 500 actions
versions.text: GTABase: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Most players get it without trying; turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI.

versions.label: B — 500, with the bracket's origin
versions.text: GamesRadar+ added '[500 in total]' as an editorial bracket (not Rockstar's wording), verified by Xarmo's report. The GamesRadar+ article URL itself could not be found, so it is not a numbered source here.

versions.label: C — 500, with profile detail
versions.text: PowerPyx: 500 actions; check the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list; turn on Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile; a demon-face icon appears at the right of the screen after each action. Tiers: Professional / Hardened / Violent / Psycho / Irredeemable (permanent).

versions.label: Agreed by all sides
versions.text: The Irredeemable status is permanent. What exactly counts as one action is explained by no source — the count is single-source and the definition is unknown.

disputes.safe: Follow the PowerPyx method, but treat it as reported, not confirmed — amber trust until a second source confirms it.
disputes.title: In The Beginning… / Capital Offense / The Truth Is Out There — method vs 'not confirmed'

versions.label: A — a method exists (PowerPyx, read 20 Nov 2026)
versions.text: In The Beginning…: Ocean View Rooftop Bar, Apple Martini. Capital Offense: blue Banshee from the showroom south of Vice City + Key Cloner. The Truth Is Out There: UFO easter egg north-west of the Starlet Motel after 02:00.

versions.label: B — not confirmed (GTABase, read 20 Nov 2026)
versions.text: All three trophies still read: 'The exact steps aren't confirmed yet; we'll add them here as soon as they are.'

disputes.safe: Chase 42 golds across the two ranges (Griffin 18, Rodgers Ranch 24). Do not treat 12 or 14 as a fact.
disputes.title: The Shootist — 12 vs 14 shooting ranges

versions.label: A — 12
versions.text: PowerPyx satellite title: 'All 12 Shooting Range Locations & 42 Gold Medals'. GTABase: '42 golds across 12 ranges'. Game-Checklists: 'All 12 shooting range courses and their 42 gold medals'.

versions.label: B — 14
versions.text: FullSweep's activities guide reports 14 challenges with 3 golds each (via search; not opened in full).

versions.label: Agreed by all sides
versions.text: 42 golds; two ranges (Griffin Shooting Range, Balsero, and Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range, Port Gellhorn); split Griffin 18 / Rodgers Ranch 24.

disputes.safe: Follow the final mission itself, not a chapter number.
disputes.title: Final-mission chapter number — Chapter 4 vs Chapter 5

versions.label: A — Chapter 4
versions.text: PowerPyx places the final mission 'Starting From Zero' in Chapter 4 (for Top Of The World, Ma and You Gotta Know When to Get Off).

versions.label: B — Chapter 5
versions.text: GTABase places 'Operation Savage Glory' (Snow Storm) in Chapter 5; eGamers notes Beebom and CULTR call the final mission Chapter 5.

versions.label: This guide
versions.text: No absolute chapter number is used for the final mission anywhere in this guide.

disputes.safe: Treat Yago's race as the one possibly missable step; save before every hourglass mission.
disputes.title: How many missables? How long to platinum?

versions.label: 1 missable
versions.text: PowerPyx, GTABase, KeenGamer, OutputLag and eGamers each count 1 possibly missable trophy.

versions.label: 2 missables
versions.text: Some top-10 lists add Catch Me If You Can as a second missable.

versions.label: 0 missables
versions.text: Push Square records no missable trophy at all.

versions.label: Time: 200 hours
versions.text: PowerPyx, GTABase and KeenGamer estimate about 200 hours to platinum.

versions.label: Time: 250-300 hours
versions.text: Push Square says 300 hours or more in its intro (250+ hours in its summary).

disputes.safe: Use Silver. The four-way agreement beats the single outlier.
disputes.title: Maximum Withdrawal — Bronze or Silver?

versions.label: Silver (40G)
versions.text: The competition kit, Exophase, GTABase and OutputLag all list Maximum Withdrawal as Silver.

versions.label: Bronze (outlier)
versions.text: Push Square lists it as Bronze. This guide does not use Push Square's grade for this trophy.

disputes.safe: Do not quote a single story-mission total. The count differs by source and by what each source counts.
disputes.title: How many story missions? 91 vs 94 vs 118

versions.text: Game-Checklists text and CryptoGames (91-93) count 91 story missions.
The Game-Checklists checklist itself counts 94.
progressbar.gg counts 118 (via search).

disputes.safe: Do not quote a single side-mission total.
disputes.title: How many side missions? 49 vs 56/57

versions.text: progressbar counts 49 side missions (via search).
Game-Checklists counts 56 or 57, depending on the page.

disputes.safe: Use the FullSweep / PowerPyx / GTABase line list (35 lines) as the working checklist; where two guides give different partial thresholds, this guide shows the stricter one.
disputes.title: 100% checklist — partial thresholds differ between guides

versions.label: A — full line list (35 lines)
versions.text: FullSweep, PowerPyx and GTABase agree on the 35 lines and most thresholds: flamingos 100/125, stunts 300/397, vehicles 200/277, meditation 15/18, challenges 70/80, cards 15/18.

versions.label: B — GTABase partial list
versions.text: GTABase's trophy page lists a partial set: all robberies (8 vaults, 39 gang ops), underwater discoveries, all range golds, all drone races, 15 Target Decks; partial — 100 optional missions, 200/277 vehicles, 100/255 animals, 15/18 meditations, 70/80 challenges, 300 stunts, 100 WAiNK.

versions.label: Weights
versions.text: GTABase gives the three groups weights (Story and Tasks 45%, Exploration and Activities 45%, Discovery 10%); PowerPyx lists the same lines without weights.
